    Kiosk locations ·

    Each kiosk shows as a pin. Set its position by typing its coordinates or with “Pick on map”. Then choose “This device” on the kiosk itself, or open its set-up link there: routes start from that kiosk and it shows “You are here”.

    Visitor engagement

    Counts are kept on this device only and contain no personal data. Export them regularly from each kiosk.
